class.name: MaszynaMoverDieselConfiguration
class.brief_description: What the Mover's model of a diesel engine is configured with.
class.description: What the Mover's model of a diesel engine is configured with: its governor, clutch, torque converter, retarder, cooling and throttle tables (LoadFIZ_Engine for DieselEngine). Shared by the diesel and the diesel-electric adapters and read by MaszynaMoverDieselEngineUnit.

members.member: The clutch's diameter [m] ([code]engageDia[/code]).
The clutch's friction ([code]engagefriction[/code]).
The clutch's greatest pressing force [lb]N[rb] ([code]engageMaxForce[/code]).
The speed above which the clutch holds without slip [km/h] ([code]minVelfullengage[/code]).
[code]Engine:WaterCoolingFanSpeed[/code] Cooling fan speed: a share of the engine's revolutions, or an absolute value when negative.
[code]Engine:HeatKFE[/code] Heat exchange factor.
[code]Engine:HeatKFO[/code] Heat exchange factor of the oil.
[code]Engine:HeatKFO2[/code] Heat exchange factor of the oil to the auxiliary water circuit.
[code]Engine:HeatKFS[/code] Heat exchange factor.
[code]Engine:HeatKV[/code] Heat exchange factor of the radiator in the air flow.
[code]Engine:HeatKW[/code] Heat exchange factor.
[code]Engine:NominalCoolingPower[/code] Nominal cooling power; the engine's heat is scaled by 1235 (su45) over it.
[code]Engine:EDS[/code] Gearbox clutch disengagement rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:EUS[/code] Gearbox clutch engagement rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:AIM[/code] Moment of inertia of the engine/shaft.
The idle speed while driving on the torque converter [1/s] ([code]nmin_hdrive[/code]).
The rise of [member mechanical_min_rpm_hydro_drive] with the power asked for [1/s] ([code]nmin_hdrive_factor[/code]).
The engine's speed while the retarder brakes [1/s] ([code]nmin_retarder[/code]).
How fast the governor raises the speed [1/s²] ([code]nreg_acc[/code]).
How fast the engine slows down ([code]RPMDecRate[/code]).
How fast the retarder's clutch engages ([code]R_ClutchSpeed[/code]).
The speed the retarder engages above [km/h] ([code]R_EngageVel[/code]).
[code]Engine:R_FRD[/code] Retarder emptying (fill decrease) rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:R_FRI[/code] Retarder filling rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:R_MinVel[/code] Minimum velocity at which the retarder operates, in km/h.
[code]Engine:R_Place[/code] Where the retarder is placed within the transmission.
[code]Engine:R_TII[/code] Retarder torque constant proportional to the square of input RPM.
[code]DList:nominalfill[/code] Nominal (rated) fuel dose, dimensionless (0..1).
[code]DList[/code] Throttle table: for each throttle position (starting from 0), the fuel dose and clutch/governor behavior.
[code]DList:Mstand[/code] Engine's own resistance torque at zero RPM, in Nm.
[code]Engine:TC_CP[/code] Relative speed at which the torque converter transitions into fluid-coupling mode.
[code]Engine:TC_FRD[/code] Torque converter emptying rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:TC_FRI[/code] Torque converter filling rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:TC_LR[/code] Torque converter lockup clutch engagement rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:TC_LS[/code] Velocity threshold at which the lockup clutch engages.
[code]Engine:TC_LT[/code] Maximum torque of the torque converter's lockup clutch, in Nm.
[code]Engine:TC_TMMax[/code] Maximum torque multiplication ratio of the torque converter.

[code]HTCList[/code] Torque converter's torque-ratio table. Recommended when the converter's real characteristic is known and cannot be reproduced with the basic formula. Each item's [member VehicleCurvePointItem.x] is the output/input RPM ratio and [member VehicleCurvePointItem.y] is the torque multiplication ratio.
[code]Engine:TC_TII[/code] Torque converter constant proportional to the square of input RPM, in Nm/(rps)².
[code]Engine:TC_TIO[/code] Torque converter constant: input-output coupling, in Nm/(rps).
[code]Engine:TC_TOO[/code] Torque converter constant proportional to the square of output RPM, in Nm/(rps)².
[code]Engine:TC_ULR[/code] Torque converter lockup clutch release rate, in 1/s.
[code]Engine:TC_ULS[/code] Velocity threshold at which the lockup clutch releases.
The speed below which the torque converter disengages [km/h] ([code]MaxVelANS[/code]).
The engine's highest speed by the vehicle's speed ([code]V2NList[/code], [code]dizel_vel2nmax_Table[/code]).

constants.constant: Retarder placed between the gearbox and the torque converter.
Retarder placed between the torque converter and the engine.
